notes:
Summary: Large ecommerce analytics org evaluating Redwood for massive-scale embeddings+rerank pipeline. Primary goal: single unified runtime that gives predictable unit cost and <120ms p95 rerank latency for top-k reranker on combined retrieval+cross-encoder stage. Target corpus: product catalog + user activity logs + support transcripts (~100M vectors initially, roadmap to 1B+).

Recent activity:
- 2026-01-18: Kickoff call (Fireflies ff_2026-01-18_seastar_kickoff). AE demo of Dedicated; SE ran baseline throughput numbers vs Pinecone on call.
- 2026-01-29: Security questionnaire submitted; legal asked for KMS/HSM details. Drive: redwood-security-answers.xlsx.
- 2026-02-02: Engineering deep-dive: ingestion pipeline (Spark -> S3 -> vectorize). Discussed chunking, canonical dedup, and TTL policies.
- 2026-02-12: Cost modeling session: target cost per query <$0.0005 by aggressive batching + prefix caching + quantized embeddings. AE provided Optimize playbook.
- 2026-02-20: Pre-POC sync; agreed on Dedicated test matrix (100M ingest, 200 qps sustained, 120ms p95 rerank).

Requirements / Preferences:
- Workload: high-throughput search (200–500 qps bursts), strict p95 latency target ~120ms for retrieval+rerank.
- Index scale: starting 100M vectors, expected growth to 1B+ within 18 months.
- Reranking: two-stage pipeline: ANN retrieval (HNSW/Faiss) -> cross-encoder reranker (top 20) for precision on legal & commerce queries.
- Embedding model: prefer open models (cost & audit) but open to Redwood-verified quantized variants; tight QA on semantic drift.
- Caching: want prefix and KV cache to reduce cost for repeated product queries.
- Batching: large batches for embedding computation during indexing and for streaming requests where latency allows.
- Fallbacks: automatic routing to cheaper model variant when Dedicated capacity under pressure; graceful degrade to approximate reranking.
- Integrations: existing Milvus cluster, S3 raw store, Kafka for incremental updates, Snowflake for metadata.

POC success criteria:
- Indexing: ingest 100M vectors within 48 hours with backpressure handling and resume semantics.
- Query cost: measured end-to-end op cost below target (show token/embedding unit math).
- Latency: 120ms p95 end-to-end for typical queries (retrieval + top20 cross-encoder).
- Quality: reranker improves top-1 accuracy by >12% on labeled set vs ANN only.

Open questions / Risks:
- Operational model: prefer Private in customer VPC; need clarity on upgrade path for 1B vectors and shard rebalancing.
- Data residency: some EU customer segments require EU-only residency—legal needs a runbook.
- Migration: existing Milvus indices have custom metadata; mapping strategy required.
- Pricing: procurement wants committed monthly capacity pricing to compare with current vendor.

Quoted customer comments: "We need predictable unit cost at scale — even small per-query delta compounds across 100M qps-days."

Next steps (short):
- Engineering POC week scheduled: ingest matrix + rerank validation (owner: Liam Chen / SE Liam).
- Security deep-dive with infra + legal (owner: Sofia Patel).
- Provide Dedicated sizing + committed pricing proposal by 2026-03-10.
